spacing-modifier.$description: Amount to multiple spacing variables by.

spacing-text-coupling.$description: How hard spacing follows body (md) font-size growth: 1 = 1:1, 0 = decoupled. Lets containers grow with text without a separate density bump.

line-height-modifier.$description: Amount to multiple line height variables by.

letter-spacing-modifier.$description: Amount to multiple letter spacing variables by.

fallback-font-size-modifier.$description: Fallback amount to multiple font size variables by in the event their specific modifier isn't set.

transition-duration-modifier.$description: Amount to multiply transition durations by. Set to 0 automatically under 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce', which collapses every duration token that opts into this modifier — components do not need their own reduced-motion rules.

min-interaction-size.$description: Minimum height and width for interactive elements like links or buttons at the WCAG 2.2 AA target-size floor.
